name: scroll-area
blurb: Styled scroll container with custom rounded scrollbars.
description: A wrapper around Radix UI's ScrollArea with themed scrollbars and support for both vertical and horizontal scrolling.
use_when: Containing overflowing content with a custom scrollbar design that matches your theme.
avoid_when: For simple overflow:auto containers — this adds styling overhead.
a11y: Uses Radix's ScrollArea for keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
